integrity: Analytical proof plus a rerunnable symbolic/numerical checker; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed interior parameter triple, a single determinant perturbation, fixed finite slow-time horizons; not a global-in-time uniform approximation or a noise result. Qualitative convergence and neutral equilibria were known. Priority of the explicit quantitative clock is provisional.
title: Exact weak-selection clock for a two-sex Volterra map near its neutral continuum
